title: Add configurable daemon logging levels
description: User requests Error, Warning, Info and Verbose logging controlled by an environment variable, default Info. Routine successful polling/read diagnostics belong to Verbose; captures and meaningful state changes belong to Info. Add consistent backend logging thresholds and safe configuration; preserve errors, privacy, functional output and startup contracts. Keep scope to logging/configuration/tests/docs, with model-free owned validation and independent correctness/engineering-quality review. No business behavior, UI, live service/configuration or data changes.

Routine polls, reads and diagnostic attempts/successes are verbose; captures and meaningful lifecycle/work changes info; retryable conditions warning; terminal/unexpected failures error. Preserve credentials/thought-text privacy at every level.
